## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D3. This is audit backlog UX-18 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Navigation and page titles · all roles.
Findings and reviewers: F-32 · reviewers C-07, A-20.
Rationale: Today is the doctor's day for doctors and the reception board for nurses. The desk surface is Front desk, Reception board and Clinic overview. A patient has a record, a Patient 360 and a directory entry. Users cannot build a stable map (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.2.3 and 3.2.4 are weak).
Proposed UX behaviour: One batch, in three languages: Today becomes My day for doctors and is never the reception board; a role that only gets the board no longer sees Today. The desk surface is Front desk in the menu and the title, with By status and By doctor as views inside it. Patients is a real page; a row opens one Patient record whose tabs depend on capability: Summary (clinicians), Details (desk), Timeline, Documents. Register patient leaves the menu and becomes a button on Front desk and Patients and a search action. Menu order per role follows blueprint section 3. Route addresses do not change; old addresses keep working. The decision whether a clinic with a nurse and no intake step gives the nurse a vitals form is recorded here and, if yes, raised as its own ticket.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 3 (role table).
Components and tokens affected: navigation.ts, AppShell items, page titles, i18n keys in en, hi and ar. Tabs on the patient record.
Front end and back end split: Front end and translations. Server capabilities unchanged: tabs only show what the role may already open.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the shell ticket. Timing: after the first pilot weeks, or before the first staff training session if the founder moves it there; never between training and the first two pilot weeks (arbitration ruling 6).
Clinical sign-off: Decision required before merge: question 21 of the validation plan (the names, and when screens may change shape), founder with the clinic, recorded on the issue.
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: staff have learned the current names; tests and training material name them.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Changing route addresses. (2) Changing what any role may see. (3) The account menu and rail labels (already landed).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given every role, when the menu and each page title are read, then the doctor's day is My day, the desk surface is Front desk, and no screen has two names
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a nurse with intake off, when the menu renders, then no two items open the same screen
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a doctor and a receptionist opening the same patient, when the record opens, then both see Patient record, the doctor with Summary and the receptionist with Details, and the receptionist's tabs hold no clinical data
- [ ] **AC4.** Given Front desk and Patients, when each renders, then Register patient is a button there and not a menu item, and the walk-in path is still at most 6 clicks new and 3 returning
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a bookmarked old address, when it is opened, then the same screen opens
- [ ] **AC6.** Given en, hi and ar, when the names are read, then all changed together, Arabic mirrors and axe finds no violation
- [ ] **AC7.** Given the issue, when it is merged, then it records the training date and that the merge is before training or after the first pilot weeks
